The UN report accusing Israel of crimes against children has been amplified in strikingly similar ways by some of the most openly antisemitic accounts on X.
The timing and messaging raise legitimate questions about whether this is organic engagement or a coordinated influence campaign.
Who is driving this amplification, and is there evidence of an organized social media operation behind it?
